models.title: Gemini, Claude or ChatGPT: I pick the right one for you
models.text: Each model has its own strengths in writing quality, speed, cost and data handling. I choose the best fit for your needs, and build the integration so you **can switch models without starting over**.

items.title: Gemini
items.text: Plays nicely with the Google ecosystem and handles large volumes of content well.

items.title: Claude
items.text: Known for the quality of its writing and for sticking closely to instructions and tone of voice.

items.title: ChatGPT
items.text: The best known: versatile, with a huge ecosystem of tools and integrations.

privacyItems: I use the business versions of these services, set up so your data isn’t used to train the models, wherever the provider allows it.
The AI only gets the data it needs, nothing more.
Projects in line with the GDPR and the transparency rules of the EU AI Act.
models.costsText: The models are pay-as-you-go. For most websites the cost is modest, and I give you a realistic estimate before we start, so there are no surprises.

faq.title: Questions about AI
faq.text: Can’t see yours? [Drop me a line](#contatti) and I’ll reply by the next business day.

items.question: Can I add AI to my current website?
items.answer: Yes. I work with WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify and custom websites, adding AI features to the dashboard you already use or to the public website, with no rebuild.

items.question: Can AI make mistakes?
items.answer: Yes, sometimes. That’s why in my projects the AI suggests and a human approves: nothing is published or sent to customers unchecked, unless you decide otherwise.

items.question: Does Google penalize AI-written copy?
items.answer: Google rewards helpful content, however it was written. The real risk is generic, mass-produced copy, which is why the AI works from your real content and a human reviews it.

items.question: Which model is best: Gemini, Claude or ChatGPT?
items.answer: It depends on the task, the budget and how you want your data handled. I know all three and pick the best fit, and the integration is built so you can switch later.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: I use the business versions of these services, send only the data that’s needed and set everything up in line with the GDPR. For especially sensitive data, we weigh up the most cautious options together.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: The project has a fixed price, agreed after the free call. Model usage is billed separately, pay-as-you-go, and I estimate it before we start.
